scientific_integrity: New analytical theorem for the stated normalized four-species mass-action ODE, with assumptions, proof and symbolic identity checks supplied. Pre-existing equilibrium, permanence and cycle-coexistence theorems are credited. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only positive initial concentrations on a fixed conserved-mass simplex and positive rate constants.
No pointwise equilibrium convergence asserted above the mass threshold; recurrent cycles are allowed.
The per-trajectory O(1/T) constant depends on the initial condition.
Invariant-measure formula assumes compact support entirely in the open positive simplex.
Novelty evidence is a bounded, not exhaustive, literature comparison.
title: Universal concentration means and critical extinction in a conservative four-species oscillator
